title: Outstandingly Tangy Mexican Chicken Tostada
description: A tangy and bouncy Mexican dish featuring dasima-kombu, perfect for a sick day, made in a kadhai and served as a tostada, this recipe is high in protein and flavor.

ingredients.name: dasima-kombu
ingredients.notes: dried and cut into small pieces

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a kadhai over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the dried dasima-kombu pieces and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 20 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the tortillas by frying them in a little oil until they are crispy.
To assemble the tostadas, place a spoonful of the chicken mixture onto a tortilla and top with shredded cheese, sour cream, and chopped cilantro.
Serve the tostadas hot, with a squeeze of lime juice.
